item.title: SEC focuses on AI oversight and governance - The Legal Wire
item.description: It is reported that the US Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) has intensified its focus on AI oversight and governance, recognizing the transformative potential of AI in financial markets. In August 2025, the SEC established an AI Task Force to centralize efforts, remove barriers to progress, and implement AI solutions that enhance the agency's mission.
